responsibility: Declares the public modref summary type and helper interfaces exposed to the rest of GCC. It defines modref_summary fields for transitive load/store trees, kills, argument escape/access flags, global-memory and side-effect markers, plus APIs to query function or call summaries, merge summaries after inlining, finalize state, and reason about implicit/interposable EAF flags. It is the external interface to the modref pass implementation in ipa-modref.cc.
same_name_distinction: Defines the externally visible modref summary type, EAF-related flag helpers, and query/update entry points other GCC code uses. Unlike gcc/ipa-modref.cc, it does not perform analysis or propagation; it exposes the summary representation and public helper interface.
